name: Soclenicant
summary: Soclenicant (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name), also known by its developmental code names BNC210 and IW-2143, is an antinicotinic agent which is under development for the treatment of anxiety disorders such as social phobia and generalized anxiety disorder, as well as for treatment of agitation, post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), and depressive disorders. It is taken by mouth.
